risks.note: Volatility in availability and prices of essential raw materials such as rubber, steel and brass can impact production costs and profitability; natural rubber and crude prices are controlled by the external environment and are beyond management's control.
Shifts such as increased demand for electric vehicles or sustainable products necessitate continuous adaptation and innovation.
Political instability, conflicts or trade disputes in key markets can disrupt operations and affect global supply chains.
Increasing adoption of digital technologies raises the threat of unauthorized access and disruption of business operations across the industry.

Retaining skilled personnel is becoming increasingly difficult in India amid rising demand for talent; Labour Codes are expected to add to the existing wage bill at the Group level; the manufacturing process is labour-intensive, requiring a large skilled and unskilled workforce.

Rising LME-Cu and LME-Zn benchmark prices combined with a volatile, upwardly mobile USD/INR led some customers to reduce or postpone purchases, affecting the ordering cycle and working-capital requirements.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Volatility in availability and prices of essential raw materials such as rubber, steel and brass can impact production costs and profitability; natural rubber and crude prices are controlled by the external environment and are beyond management's control.
- Shifts such as increased demand for electric vehicles or sustainable products necessitate continuous adaptation and innovation.
- Political instability, conflicts or trade disputes in key markets can disrupt operations and affect global supply chains.
- Increasing adoption of digital technologies raises the threat of unauthorized access and disruption of business operations across the industry.
- Retaining skilled personnel is becoming increasingly difficult in India amid rising demand for talent; Labour Codes are expected to add to the existing wage bill at the Group level; the manufacturing process is labour-intensive, requiring a large skilled and unskilled workforce.
- Rising LME-Cu and LME-Zn benchmark prices combined with a volatile, upwardly mobile USD/INR led some customers to reduce or postpone purchases, affecting the ordering cycle and working-capital requirements.
- Weak performance attributed to unfavourable weather/shorter summer season, seasonally weak second quarter, and competitive pressure from low-priced imports that make it difficult to scale domestic production despite secured technical approvals.
- Major economies moving toward localisation over globalisation could disrupt import-export flows; central-bank interest rate actions to fight inflation could curb growth and act as a dampener for exports.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Building a vertically integrated platform spanning raw materials, engineering, manufacturing and customer delivery across the Automotive, Metals and Climate Control verticals.
- Amalgamating Tritonvalves Climatech into Triton Valves Limited to create a combined Automotive + Climate Control entity, unlocking procurement/production/dispatch synergies and tax efficiencies.
- Expanding presence in Tyre Pressure Monitoring Systems (TPMS) and Electric Vehicle (EV) applications while bolstering the core tyre and vehicle-OE businesses.
- Metals segment moving beyond volume growth toward a product pyramid …
